stem: According to the Northwest Ordinance, which condition did a U.S. territory have to meet in order to apply for statehood?

options.label: A
options.text: Have a population of sixty thousand free settlers

options.label: B
options.text: Hold a vote on whether to become a free or slave territory

options.label: C
options.text: Establish one public school per district

options.label: D
options.text: Have a territorial governor appointed by the president
